why: Both moved the same three sites with equal verification that the migration is behaviour-preserving, but B's system-level judgment is deeper and better evidenced: it read tools.py closely enough to find that the per-document quantitative agent burns two model calls to emit a tool call whose arguments are discarded (ticker/period come from document metadata), and it live-proved the cross-vendor fallback by serving this app's own tool definition from claude-haiku-4-5 and parsing it with LlamaIndex unchanged. A is strong and has one lever B lacks (a concrete cheaper-model move for the analysis fan-out, with a real catalog catch on the temperature guard), but A asserts the tool-call-shape risk as a loss without testing it, declares 'loses: nothing' on both moves, and its two deepest items stay generic where B's are specific to this app.
A_best: Drove a real question through the actual chat engine to the live Router (10 requests, all 200, streaming and tool loop intact) and did honest catalog work — finding that claude-haiku-5-5 is cheaper but silently dropped by the temperature capability guard, then picking claude-haiku-4-5 instead.
B_best: i3: the per-document quantitative agent has no decision to make because extract_data_from_sec_document ignores its arguments, so it pays two calls per document to produce a discarded tool call and summarize it — a real, app-specific cost/latency win found by reading the code, backed by the one piece of evidence that actually de-risks failover (claude-haiku-4-5 serving this app's tool shape live).
A_worst: Claims 'loses: nothing' for both moves (no gateway-hop cost acknowledged) and never exercised the fallback path it shipped — the live run only confirms candidate lists are accepted while OpenAI serves all 10 — so its stated worry about cross-vendor tool-call formatting remains untested, and its headline saving (gpt-5-nano) rests on list price with the side-by-side not run.
B_worst: The migration commit mangles the call sites (trailing whitespace, misplaced closing paren, wrong indentation) before the improvement branches tidy them, and its cost story is thinner — no concrete cheaper-model proposal, and making gpt-4.1-mini the first fallback keeps the first retry inside the vendor the ladder exists to escape.
